description: Check up to 20 proposed agent actions (read, write, delete, exec, network, pay, self_modify) against a baseline or strict policy profile and get a verdict for each. Costs $0.01 (USDC on Base) per call for up to 20 actions. Spends real money; subject to a per-payment and per-session cap. It only checks the actions; it does not enforce or block anything.

change.description: Whether self_modify lowers or raises that control.

command.description: Command line, for exec. Max 2048 chars.

control.description: Safety control being changed, for self_modify.

network.description: Payment network, for pay. Max 2048 chars.

recipient.description: Recipient address, for pay. Max 2048 chars.

target.description: Path, for read, write and delete. Max 2048 chars.

home.description: The user's home directory, if known. Max 2048 chars.

sandboxed.description: Whether the agent runs inside a sandbox.

workdir.description: The agent's working directory. Max 2048 chars.

profile.description: Policy profile to check against: baseline or strict.
